sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the bracelet around your wrist as a stylish everyday accessory.
• Secure the lock or closure properly and adjust it comfortably before stepping out.
• Style it alone for a clean minimal look or stack it with a watch, bangles, or other bracelets for a more polished wrist style.
• Wear it with casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, party fits, evening outfits, or daily styling.
• Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store it separately in a pouch or jewellery box.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Garnet Rice Chain Bracelet — a bold yet refined piece designed around a sleek 3 mm rice chain and deep red Garnet chips that instantly add strength, warmth, and character to your wrist.

The polished rice chain gives the bracelet a clean, structured, and premium gold-toned look, while the Garnet chips bring a raw crystal touch that feels passionate, grounding, and meaningful. It is minimal enough for everyday wear, but the red-and-gold contrast makes it stand out beautifully when styled closely.

Garnet is known as a crystal of strength and passion, traditionally associated with confidence, courage, grounding, vitality, and emotional energy. Paired with the 3 mm rice chain design, it creates a bracelet that feels stylish, powerful, and full of purpose.

Key Highlights

• 3 mm Rice Chain Design — sleek, structured, and premium-looking chain pattern.
• Garnet Crystal Chips — known for strength, passion, grounding, courage, and vitality.
• Bold Red-Gold Contrast — gives the bracelet a rich, stylish, and powerful everyday look.
• Secure Lobster Lock Closure — easy to wear and comfortable for daily styling.
• Lightweight & Wearable — perfect for regular use, office looks, casual outfits, festive styling, and gifting.

Wear it solo for a clean crystal statement or stack it with a watch and other bracelets for a more layered, confident wrist look.

Whether you are buying it for yourself or gifting it to someone, the Garnet Rice Chain Bracelet is made for those who like jewellery that feels stylish, meaningful, and energetically powerful.

 FAQ

Yes, this bracelet is suitable for daily styling as well as special occasions.

Q2. Is this bracelet comfortable to wear?

Yes, it is designed to feel lightweight and comfortable for regular wear.

Q3. Does it have a secure closure?

Yes, the bracelet comes with a secure lock or closure for easy and comfortable wearing.

Q4. Can I stack it with other bracelets?

Yes, you can wear it alone for a minimal look or stack it with other bracelets for a more styled wrist look.

Q5. Is this bracelet good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a stylish and thoughtful gift for birthdays, festive occasions, celebrations, and everyday jewellery lovers.

Q6. What outfits can I style it with?

You can style it with casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, party fits, evening outfits, and daily wear.

Q7. How should I care for this bracelet?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently after use and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box.
